title: Stewed Chickpeas in a Chinese Zesty Sauce
description: A fusion dish combining the flavors of Chinese cuisine with the comfort of a hearty stew. The zesty sauce brings a tangy kick to the rich flavors of the chickpeas.

ingredients.name: ethiopian stew spices
ingredients.notes: or 1 tsp ground cumin and 1 tsp smoked paprika

instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the Ethiopian stew spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, zesty sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the chopped green onions.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
